search.title: Abbreviation and bibliography search
search.lead: Look up the abbreviations used in Manfred Mayrhofer’s etymological dictionary of Old Indo-Aryan (EWAia) and their full forms.

form.label: Search EWAia abbreviations
form.hint: Enter part of an abbreviation or full form. Case does not matter. To list every entry, leave the field empty and press Search.

status.loadingBody: You can keep editing your search term and options.
status.emptyBody: Try a shorter search term or search in both the abbreviation and the full form.
status.noFieldsBody: Select Abbreviation, Full form, or both.
status.errorTitle: The entries could not be loaded
status.errorBody: Your search term and options have been kept. Check your connection and try again.

footer.about: Abbreviations and full forms from the list of abbreviations in Mayrhofer’s EWAia, converted by OCR and AI-assisted formatting. Entries may contain typos and wrong types.
footer.rights: This project’s code is licensed under the MIT License. The terms for the abbreviation data are undecided, and the MIT License does not apply to the data.
footer.reportNote: Reports become public GitHub issues. A GitHub account is required, and anything you write can be read by anyone. Do not include personal information.
